mintAuthority.summary: EURQ is issuer-minted by Quantoz across Ethereum (3/5 HadronMultisig owner, 3/5 proxy admin), Polygon (3/5 HadronMultisig owner, 3/5 proxy admin), XRPL (single master-key issuer account), and Algorand (single manager account). All mint-capable surfaces confirmed.

controls.label: EURQ Algorand ASA manager
controls.evidence: Algorand ASA 2768422954: manager account UALFRIYMF7HTTWPGJCBEKJ2AIROCAQR57SO7ZK7LW2SFXQF6346PSDDU2M; freeze/clawback/reserve account 3PJ3E3D6XI7YWMJAUX6WDCHWZ4GC2WHTAQIWJBYVJ326LM2I6NSMSLGCDY. Single-account issuer-backend custody; Algorand ASA minting is natively single-key (no multisig ASA standard).

review.evidence: Ethereum (2026-05-25): owner 0x284Df7B9 3/5 HadronMultisig, proxy admin 0xa6724f79 3/5; Polygon block 88323602: owner 0x84e8d731 3/5, proxy admin 0x2f875fa2 3/5. XRPL issuer account confirmed (no signer list, master key enabled). Algorand ASA 2768422954 manager/freeze confirmed as issuer-operated accounts. All addressable mint-capable surfaces confirmed; XRPL and Algorand issuer-backend corroborated by Quantoz EMI issuance model. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No public dated independent EURQ reserve-to-liability report was located; Quantoz provides a live issuer dashboard and generic periodic-audit claims without a named attestor, cadence, or latest artifact. The DNB public register exactly matches Quantoz Payments B.V. as an electronic-money institution and EURQ EMT issuer, providing prudential supervision. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer multisigs and single-key accounts mint without a firm cap, DNB supervises Quantoz Payments, and the ad-hoc self-reported snapshot is not a recurring whole-supply attestation.
